45 ارياط [?] Aryat, Æthiops.
46 ابرهة الاشرم Abrabah Alashram: ita à cica-
trice vulneris ipsi in facie inflicti denominatus. Hic est
qui صاحب الفيل i. e. Dominus Elephanti audit, ejus
nempe, à quo capitulo Alcorani quod سورة
الفيل dicitur, titulus. Caput ipsum, quod & breve sit
& ad illustrandam historiam faciat, apponemus.

page.notes: The Arabic verse block (Sura 105) and the Arabic names in lines 45 and 46 are read with doubt and may contain errors; uncertain words are marked [?]. The Arabic sign "‹" after "ارياط" is unclear and was left out. The right margin note at the bottom right is in Arabic with an italic Latin word; its letters are hard to read and not certain. The word "Interpretes" is split at the line end: "Interpre" stands in the text and "tes" is printed as catchword, with no hyphen visible. Long s was rendered as plain s throughout. The "*" in "è * luto" is printed as is. Printed text is in Latin with Arabic; no Greek is present.
